About The Joinery

A contemporary performance venue and streaming studio

Purpose-built for both live events and digital production, The Joinery blends the intimacy of a black box studio with the technical capabilities of a professional filming environment. It’s perfect for:

  • Business meetings & conferences – seating up to 15 around a boardroom table with cameras, lighting and high-speed internet for hybrid or online participation
  • Performances, workshops & community activities – welcoming up to 35 attendees for presentations, classes, rehearsals and small-scale performances

Whether you’re hosting a creative workshop, delivering staff training, recording content or staging a performance, The Joinery offers a comfortable, adaptable setting that supports your work.

Capacity & Facilities

Fully equipped for meetings, performances and digital production

The Joinery is designed to make your event run smoothly, offering a range of professional facilities:

  • Seating for 15 in boardroom layout
  • Capacity for up to 35 attendees for performances or group events
  • Multi-camera setup, lighting and AV equipment
  • High-speed internet for streaming and online meetings
  • Purpose-built drapes and soundproofing, creating a true black box theatre
  • Projector, hearing loop, and on-site toilet facilities
  • Optional refreshments available on request

The space is ready for corporate gatherings, creative sessions or high-quality filming.

We charge a day rate of £250 for all bookings.

For bookings or further details, get in touch at info@settlestories.org.uk..

Hire Take a Look

Take a look inside The Joinery, our contemporary performance venue and professional streaming studio in the heart of Settle.

Our gallery showcases the flexibility of the space – from meetings and training days to workshops, performances, podcast recordings and live-streamed events. With capacity for up to 35 people and full AV, lighting and multi-camera facilities, The Joinery is designed for both in-person and hybrid events.

Whether you’re planning a business meeting, creative workshop or filmed production in the Yorkshire Dales, The Joinery offers a fully equipped, adaptable venue with a warm Yorkshire welcome.

Ready to bring your event to life? Get in touch to enquire about venue hire.
